method: Opened my two assigned images (rejudge positions 2 and 5) one at a time, then decoded all 61 full-size BT.709 frames from 171.505 to 173.507 s with ffmpeg (seek after -i, select filter), measured frame-to-frame difference, edge rows and phone-screen sharpness, and inspected full frames and crops of the card tops, phone top and bottom, captions and pills.

entries.note: Both sides are the phone card (Adjust Photo screen recording of the real deck-chair photo) with the pill 'Real picture of me - not AI-generated' below the phone, nothing over face or belly, no caption on the card. The 'cards out' boundary shows no visible change (full-frame mean diff 0.83, only the in-recording cursor moves). No line, freeze or wrong layout.

Beach runner card keeps moving right up to the cut (last frame 172.473, diff 2.04 vs previous); clean hard cut to the phone card at 172.506 (diff 73.6), no stray, black or frozen frame, no edge lines (outer rows within 2 levels of inner rows on all 61 frames). Single burned AI-GENERATED chip on the runner card, no second pill. Caption 'years younger.' completes the sentence 'And you'll feel 20 years younger.' on the blue field below the card, is on screen from about 171.77 to 172.473, and does not carry onto the phone card; the phone card shows only its pill, clear of the phone frame. Doubtful but not called: (1) the first three phone frames (172.506 to 172.573) show the screen recording soft with a faint crop grid and lifted olive blacks, sharpening by 172.606 (text sharpness 7.5, 17.6, 24.6, then steady); the phone card geometry is fixed, so this is the iOS crop UI fading inside the source recording, about 0.1 s, not a compositing glitch. (2) The runner's hair touches or is just clipped by the card's top border on some frames (e.g. 171.81, 172.47); that is the card crop of the AI clip, not the frame edge, so not hair_top. (3) The beach card repeats a near-identical frame every fifth frame (24 fps clip in 29.97), normal cadence, not a freeze.
